requests.missing: These create operations have no durable request identity. A lost response, client replay, or concurrent duplicate can therefore create more than one logical mutation. Annotation reproduction is evidence of the general reliability gap, not a reason to deduplicate annotation content.
requests.scope: authenticated principal + uppercase HTTP method + canonical route template + exact Idempotency-Key
requests.requestFingerprint: REQUIRED over normalized validated body, bound path parameters, and operation-significant query parameters. Authentication, Idempotency-Key, tracing, and transport headers are excluded.
requests.sameRequest: Same scope and same fingerprint returns the same logical mutation/result, including after a lost response.
requests.mismatch: Same scope and key with a different fingerprint is refused with HTTP 409 and code IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE_MISMATCH; it performs no mutation.
requests.concurrency: A database uniqueness boundary selects one executor. A duplicate waits and replays the stored result; if its request budget expires first it receives HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS with Retry-After: 1 and may retry. It never performs a second mutation.
requests.compatibility: The header is optional. Absence preserves legacy behavior for the compatibility window. Existing current-v1 body identities clientKey and idempotencyKey remain accepted on the operations that already contract them.
requests.prohibition: No content or semantic deduplication by annotation text, quote, paragraph, date, CNR, authority, matter title, or other domain content.
requests.naturalIdentityExclusions: POST /matters/:id/authorities is protected by its live database uniqueness identity. POST /citations/copies is protected by authenticated user plus required clientKey. Neither receives a second competing identity contract in R16.
requests.failureSemantics: Validation failure before mutation does not consume the key. Server failure before mutation rolls back and releases the claim. The durable mutation and completed replay result commit atomically; a retry after an unknown/lost response replays the success.
requests.schemaDelta: Additive request metadata only at the contract layer: optional Idempotency-Key. Durable implementation requires LCC persistence and uniqueness work, but R16 does not prescribe per-domain columns or authorize a database migration by NEW3.
requests.semanticDelta: Current-v1 authenticated create writes gain an opt-in exactly-one-logical-mutation retry contract while requests without the header retain their legacy behavior.
